page.layout: One title page, all text centred. Top block: printed title lines in large capitals and italic. Middle: a woodcut engraving (eagle with banner) with no text except the banner words. Below the engraving: the printer's imprint and the date.

main_text.l: Quid Antitrinitarij sive SOCINIANI Haeretici qui se
doctrinam de Sacro-Sancta Trinitate simulant, moliantur circa
Religionem & Remp. adeoque totam Ecclesiam Christianam, praefertim Reformatam, tàm in his Provincijs Foederati Belgij quàm

l.i: Ad Illustriss. & Potentiss. Ordines Generales Foederati Belgij.

main_text.l: Apud FRANCISCUM HEGERUM, è Regione Academiae.

page.notes: Woodcut engraving between the author line and the imprint: an eagle with spread wings standing over two smaller birds, with a ribbon banner above it reading VIVIMUS EX UNO (banner text transcribed above). The date is printed in the old reversed-C form (CIↃ IↃC XXXIII), transcribed as MDCXXXIII. Long s is printed as f in "fine" and "Arminianismi", and in "ostenditur", which is printed with a long s and transcribed as plain s. The name line "NICOLAO" has a final letter that is printed with a tail and may be a Q-form O; it is read as O. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
